text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's 1995/96 state budget deficit fell to 600 million dinars. The projected deficit for the fiscal year that ended on June 30 was 1.32 billion dinars.
- Kuwait's central bank is to take part in a Gulf central banks' meeting in Bahrain on Saturday.
- A government committee supervising a free-trade zone project drafted a contract for the zone's management which is to be signed with the National Real Estate Company.
- The Interior Ministry seeks to end a hunger strike by 25 inmates at a deportation prison.
- Former parliamentarian Ali al-Baghli, who failed to be re-elected in parliamentary polls on October 7, filed a complaint to Kuwait's constitutional court challenging the election's results.
